narrative.overview: QuizHub channels the kinetic excitement, tactile satisfaction, and rewarding momentum of an upscale modern arcade. Knowledge testing is elevated from a sterile chore into an engaging, celebratory tournament arena. The aesthetic balances vibrant gamification energy with clean structural clarity: high-contrast dark cosmic canvas or crisp daylight whites, accented by vivid arcade violet, glowing status lights, and instantly recognizable difficulty tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Kinetic, electric brand violet against deep cosmic indigo and crisp daylight neutrals.
Floating ambient depth with subtle hairline borders and multi-layer soft shadows.
Distinct semantic difficulty coding (Emerald, Amber, Rose) guiding user quiz choices.
Dual-font typography pairing geometric humanism (Outfit) with high-legibility monospace figures (JetBrains Mono).
Snappy, purposeful micro-interactions with graceful reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The Spotlight Accent Rule
rules.body: Arcade Violet is reserved for the primary interactive pathway and winning states; it covers less than 15% of any viewport to preserve its punch and authority.

rules.name: The Difficulty Triage Rule
rules.body: Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty colors must never be swapped or replaced with brand violet; they are cognitive invariants across cards, filters, and question badges.

rules.name: The Monospace Numeric Rule
rules.body: Any number that counts down, increments, represents virtual currency, or marks an index must render in JetBrains Mono (font-mono) to prevent tabular layout shifts.

rules.name: The Ambient Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards must never remain static on hover; they subtly lift (-2px translateY) and emit a soft ambient glow to invite engagement.

dos: Do format all timers, question counts, and coin values in JetBrains Mono (font-mono).
Do use strict semantic difficulty colors (Emerald, Amber, Rose) on quiz cards and filters.
Do pair card elevation with a 1px border (border-border) so contrast is preserved across dark and light modes.
Do keep button and control corner radii consistent at 8px (rounded-md) and cards at 12px (rounded-xl).
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by disabling decorative keyframe pulses and bounce animations.
donts: Don't use generic corporate gray-on-gray styling or clinical data spreadsheets for quiz experiences.
Don't clutter screens with childish novelty stickers, unreadable cartoon fonts, or unprompted confetti.
Don't use Arcade Violet as a general background fill; it is strictly an interactive and celebratory accent.
Don't hardcode raw hex values in component styling; always reference semantic tokens.
